paper_id: Dialogue Discourse-Aware Graph Model and Data Augmentation for Meeting Summarization__oa_W3188385856
title: Dialogue Discourse-Aware Graph Model and Data Augmentation for Meeting Summarization
motivation: 现有方法将会议视为线性序列，忽视话语间的丰富交互关系；且训练数据严重不足，模型性能受限
problem_framing: 将会议 utterances 与 discourse relations 构建为 Levi graph，通过图编码器建模话语交互，用 QA relation 构建伪摘要语料
key_insight: QA discourse relation 识别的 question 往往包含核心话题/概念，可作为后续讨论的伪摘要，实现 data augmentation
method_signature: DDAMS(meeting graph + RGCN + pointer decoder) + DDADA(QA-based pseudo corpus pretraining)
evaluation_criteria: ROUGE-1/2/L F1 scores; human evaluation on relevance and informativeness
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: DDAMS+DDADA (w/o fine-tune) only achieves basic effect - fine-tuning is essential for good performance
evidence_for_taste: hindering the exploration of inherently rich interactive relations
a question often sparks a discussion in a meeting
the scale of corpus is significant to the performance
uniformly accepting information from different discourse relations is not suitable
Ground truth obtains the highest scores
thinking_moves: 将会议建模从线性序列改为图结构，显式编码话语间的 discourse relations
观察 QA relation 的语义功能：question 往往蕴含讨论的核心概念
利用此观察构建伪语料解决数据不足，将问题生成作为预训练目标
区分 in/out edges 解决不同类型顶点特征空间差异问题
验证各 discourse relation 类型的贡献差异，Conditional/Result 等更关键
